title: The Orchard of Sandpiper Point
author: Emrys Zhou
blurb: Kestrel Crane, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
